detail: The case asserts ProblemDetails detail `Order 999999 was not found.`. The story only says to return 404 when the order doesn't exist and gives no message. Assert status 404 and a non-empty detail (or that it is not the old 500 message). The same applies to TC-BUG-10-06.

TC-BUG-10-09 and TC-BUG-10-10 assert the empty-GUID 400 and its exact body text, which the story does not mention. Keep them as regression guards if wanted, but state in the plan that they cover behavior outside the story, or drop the body-text assertion.
